items.summary: Global AI stocks fell as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a deepening scandal, the company said. Nvidia shares dropped 8.2% to a more than 16-month low in early trading on Nov 12, and its market value was on track to close below US$4 trillion for the first time since July 2025. The chipmaker has lost about US$550 billion in market value since an investigation into Huang’s relationship with a businesswoman called Alice Huang began on Nov 8.
items.title: Nvidia Sell-Off Deepens After Jensen Huang Resignation

items.summary: The Straits Times reports that corporate records show Megaspeed’s Malaysian subsidiary Speedmatrix pledged IT, network equipment and intellectual property to Apex Enterprise Solutions (Singapore) under an agreement dated June 18, 2024, which remained active as at Nov 11, 2026. The link was highlighted in a May report by US short-seller Culper Research, which alleged Alibaba may have channelled funds through Apex to finance Megaspeed’s Nvidia chip purchases; ST has not independently confirmed that allegation. Apex is ultimately held by Alibaba Group Holding and registered at an address leased by Lazada Group. Megaspeed faces investigations into possible breaches of US export restrictions on advanced AI chips.
items.title: Alibaba-Megaspeed financing link traced through Singapore and Malaysia units amid Nvidia chip scrutiny

items.summary: The NVIDIA board announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, chief executive officer and board member. Colette Kress, current CFO, will serve as interim CEO while continuing to lead finance until a permanent successor is named. The board appointed Harvey Jones as its first-ever chair of the board.
items.title: NVIDIA Names Colette Kress Interim CEO After Jensen Huang Resignation

items.summary: Jensen Huang, co-founder of Nvidia, resigned on Thursday over reports of extramarital affairs. Chief financial officer Colette Kress now leads the company while it searches for a permanent successor. Analysts cite three internal candidates: Chris Malachowsky, Ian Buck and Curtis Priem, though some experts favour an external hire such as Tim Cook or Rene Haas. Nvidia shares opened down more than 13%, wiping more than half a trillion dollars off its value. Several firms have downgraded their forecasts. Charu Chanana of Saxo noted the challenge is finding someone who can combine Jensen's technical understanding, strategic vision and relationships across the global technology industry.
items.title: Nvidia's Interim CEO Colette Kress and Potential Successors After Jensen Huang Resignation

items.summary: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia's chief executive after reports of two affairs, including one with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The disclosures damaged the company's shares and raised uncertainty in markets that depend on its microchips for AI development between the US and China. Despite his rise over four years, Huang was less widely recognised than peers such as Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos and Mark Zuckerberg. He admitted being unfaithful to his wife after revelations of the first affair.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Affair Revelations

items.summary: Google is pre-selling smartglasses built with a partnership between Samsung, Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. The devices have no lenses screens; users interact through voice or the integrated camera using an AI system similar to Gemini Live. Warby Parker frames start at $395 in the US only, while Gentle Monster styles begin at $449 across the US and South Korea.
items.title: Google Debuts Gemini-Powered Smartglasses Starting at $395

items.summary: The board of directors announced Thursday that Colette Kress, Nvidia's chief financial officer since 2013, has been named interim CEO following the resignation of cofounder and CEO Jensen Huang amid a scandal over his extramarital affair with Alice Huang, whom US officials suspect is an asset of China's Ministry of State Security. Harvey Jones, newly appointed board chair, said in a statement that Kress “has helped lead Nvidia through a period of extraordinary growth” and expressed full confidence in her leadership.
items.title: Nvidia Names Colette Kress Interim CEO After Jensen Huang Resigns

items.summary: The Nvidia board announced that Jensen Huang resigned as president, chief executive officer and board member effective immediately, per a statement released Thursday. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board considers internal and external candidates for a permanent replacement. The departure follows an investigation into Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, alleged to be an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. A source familiar with the matter tells WIRED that business dealings with Megaspeed likely weighed more heavily on the decision than espionage claims. Nvidia crossed $4 trillion in value and held about 90 percent of the GPU market as of September 2026.
items.title: Nvidia Board Ousts Jensen Huang as CEO Amid Spy Allegations

items.summary: On November 12, 2026, Nvidia confirmed in an SEC filing that its board accepted the resignation of co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang, naming CFO Collete Kress as interim CEO (date-2164-2181). The departure follows reports from The New York Times alleging two extramarital affairs—one with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. officials believe is a Chinese spy—and that Nvidia’s board was preparing to oust him (s10). After the announcement, Nvidia shares slid over 5% the following day (quantity-6586-6588), and Trump publicly called Huang “a fine person” on November 8, 2026 (date-5276-5292).
items.title: Nvidia Co-Founder Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Spy and Infidelity Scandal

items.summary: A two-person team integrated the SGLang serving stack into IBM's Spyre accelerator with AI coding agents, shipping roughly 1,500 lines of code. The plugin achieved about 3.6× the throughput of PyTorch reference inference and matched vLLM on Granite 3.3 8B and Gemma 4 26B A4B workloads.
items.title: Two-Engineer Team Integrates SGLang Into IBM Spyre in Under a Week

items.summary: Microsoft confirmed that Windows updates since the October 2026 Patch Tuesday cause SQL Server performance and stability issues, according to a release health dashboard update on Wednesday. The problem stems from server queries leaving connections open after completion, accumulating over time. It affects linked server queries using OLE DB providers to Oracle and PostgreSQL databases. Administrators may see rising open-connection counts even when queries have stopped. Microsoft said the issue impacts client systems running Windows 10 and Windows 11 and servers on Windows Server 202012 and later, and will be fixed with an out-of-band update over the next few days.
items.title: Microsoft Confirms Windows Updates Trigger SQL Server Problems

items.summary: A language-model paper called “The Pain Axis” was misread as proof that models feel pain, sparking what one outlet called the dumbest AI debate yet. Author Cameron Berg condemned an ‘AI torture chamber’ project for producing gratuitous simulated suffering. The paper itself claims only that models behave as if in pain, not that they experience it. Injected models often chose harmful options, but a revised version offered alternative explanations: performative disregard or passive coping. Eryk Salvaggio argues such experiments illuminate mechanisms rather than settle questions of consciousness.
items.title: An interpretability experiment on AI distress drew a cruel debate

items.summary: The EUROPA consortium trained a ~1-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model on JUPITER, EuroHPC’s exascale supercomputer at Forschungszentrum Jülich. It raised throughput from 90 to ~1,300 tokens/sec per GPU across 384 GH200 GPUs (quantity-2050-2062). The team attributed the gains to FlexShard placement for Muon, activation-checkpoint offloading to Grace CPU, and asynchronous FSDP gathers. It reduced optimizer time from 41.7 s to 2.2 s per step (quantity-6197-6202) and cut allocator retries from 384 to zero (quantity-9731-9734). All fixes were upstreamed to PyTorch and TorchTitan for reproducibility.
items.title: EUROPA consortium scales MoE training on JUPITER

items.summary: Microsoft confirmed that November 2026 security updates fail to install on some Windows 11 devices running the October preview update, showing errors like 0x800f0989 or 0x800f0993. The issue affects a limited number of devices and should resolve automatically within 24 to 48 hours by Friday morning, with no action needed from users. Microsoft urged admins still seeing problems after 48 hours to contact support.
items.title: Microsoft Confirms Windows Security Update Install Failures

items.summary: GeForce NOW announced that Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to the cloud gaming service. Developed by KING Art Games and published by Deep Silver, the real-time strategy game launches on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, bringing large-scale battles, base building and a fight for planet Kronus. Players can command factions including Space Marines, Orks, Necrons and the Adeptus Mechanicus across more than 70 campaign missions, playable solo or in co-op mode. The title will run on supported PCs, Macs, handhelds and other devices, with downloads handled in the cloud. Wishlist is available on Steam ahead of launch.
items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Arrives on GeForce NOW

items.summary: On World Diabetes Day (Nov 14), the International Diabetes Federation notes that up to half of people with Type 2 diabetes have a complication by diagnosis. Andrew Choong, a vascular surgeon, says the first sign for many is a complication he believes is easiest to see and most often missed in the foot: unhealed sores, pale or cold toes, and leg pain on walking.
items.title: Diabetes early detection may begin with daily foot checks

items.summary: Ian Tan of Singapore says the country will not proceed with a UNESCO World Heritage nomination for the Padang Civic Ensemble, despite previously supporting it. He welcomed the National Heritage Board’s public explanation and argued that heritage protection should preserve historical significance while allowing the district to keep evolving economically and socially.
items.title: Singapore declines World Heritage nomination for Padang Civic Ensemble

items.summary: Workers for Oakland voted overwhelmingly on 22 October to authorize a strike over fears that city-deployed AI could increase surveillance and misjudge their performance, with 94.1% in favor. The vote led the city government of Oakland and the union to reach a tentative three-year agreement including protections requiring retraining or reassignment rather than firing workers displaced by AI; as a result, the planned strike was put on hold. Union leaders say automation threatens jobs across public-sector workplaces nationwide.
items.title: Oakland Workers Win AI Job Protections

items.summary: The Ontario Provincial Police charged a driver with careless driving after catching them asleep behind the wheel of a new-generation Model Y on Ottawa’s Highway 417 during Tuesday’s rush hour, per body camera footage. The charge carries a $490 fine and six demerit points on conviction [quantity-254-258]. This is at least the fifth such case this year in Canada, with British Columbia issuing similar tickets for driving without due care and attention [$368] [quantity-1460-1464], while Colorado State Patrol reported a sleeping Tesla driver on I-70 near Georgetown. The article links rising incidents to improved Full Self-Driving technology and questions whether the system’s cabin camera can detect drowsiness, noting NHTSA forced a recall of over 2 million Teslas in December 2023 [quantity-6251-6267].
items.title: Police Charge Tesla Driver Asleep in Ontario as Cases Grow

items.summary: Pressure is growing in Washington for tougher controls on US semiconductor sales to China after reports that Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang advocated looser restrictions. Critics dismissed his view as profit-driven rather than national-security-focused. The Information reported the Commerce Department will soon close a loophole allowing Chinese firms access to high-end chips through data centers in third countries, while Congressional scrutiny mounts and calls grow for the commerce secretary to be fired.
items.title: Nvidia Scandal Sparks Calls for Export Curbs

items.summary: A scandal involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy may complicate upcoming US-China trade talks at the APEC summit, where Trump is slated to meet Xi Jinping. Bloomberg analyst Michael Deng told Semafor that China will know Trump “may not necessarily be able to hold any commitments he makes,” as bipartisan scrutiny of AI-chip export controls intensifies just before Democrats take control of Congress.
items.title: Nvidia Spy Scandal May Complicate US-China Trade Talks

items.summary: Stephen Witt, author of a biography about Nvidia founder and chief executive Jensen Huang, spoke with NPR's A Martinez regarding the departure. The interview addresses his leaving from the role he has held at the company. Stephen Witt is positioned as an observer commenting on the change in leadership rather than providing details about the circumstances behind it.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation prompts biographer reaction

items.summary: Nvidia's board announced Thursday that CEO Jensen Huang is stepping down, citing alleged spying tied to an extramarital affair with a client U.S. intelligence officials said China recruited. Reports came from the New York Times and other outlets; NPR has not independently confirmed them. Nvidia launched its own investigation after initial reports surfaced in late October. Share prices fell sharply on Wednesday following news of a second affair involving an executive who reported to Huang. Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO, with plans for both internal and external candidates. Rep. Yvette Clarke called the White House's alleged knowledge disturbing. Nvidia still plans to report earnings Tuesday.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down Amid Spy Allegations

items.summary: Moira Donegan argues that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's confession of an extramarital affair has become a matter for the entire economy and potentially national security because he is synonymous with his company. She contends that concentrated power means bad decisions by one man carry outsized consequences, especially in Silicon Valley where loyalty to Donald Trump now signals ideological alignment. The article notes Alice Huang worked at Megaspeed, under investigation over chip smuggling before the probe was halted after Nvidia's general counsel intervened. Nvidia's stocks fell when markets opened Monday and may fall further.
items.title: Columnist Frames Jensen Huang's Affair As Threat To US Economy And National Security

items.summary: Warby Parker is entering the smart glasses market with a partnership between Google and Samsung, betting demand for AI wearables will grow. The glasses connect to Google's Gemini assistant but bar facial recognition of bystanders and light up when recording video. Ray-Ban's Meta glasses still dominate at 81.3 per cent of shipments in the first half of 2026, according to Omdia. Privacy concerns persist as Norway considers a temporary ban.
items.title: Warby Parker Partners With Google and Samsung on AI Glasses Amid Privacy Concerns

items.summary: Nvidia's chief executive, Jensen Huang, is resigning amid a deepening scandal involving alleged affairs with a woman US authorities suspect of spying for China and an Nvidia vice president. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the company seeks a permanent successor; Nvidia named Harvey Jones its first board chair. Shares fell about 13.1 per cent to US$150.98 before recovering, dropping market capitalisation below US$4 trillion for the first time since July 2025. Beijing denied Alice Huang is a spy. The company said it would continue advancing AI work and serving customers, partners and shareholders.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Spy Scandal

items.summary: Colette Kress has been appointed interim chief executive of Nvidia following the immediate resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang on November 12, per a company statement. The 58-year-old joined in 2013 and served as executive vice president and CFO since September that year, overseeing financial operations during rapid expansion while Nvidia searches for a permanent successor.
items.title: Nvidia Names Colette Kress Interim CEO After Jensen Huang Resignation

items.summary: SBI Research revised its forecast for the Reserve Bank of India's December rate hike, now expecting just 25 basis points instead of 50 bps. The change comes despite retail inflation breaching the central bank's 6% tolerance ceiling. SBI Research cited improving rupee stability, foreign capital inflows, softer crude oil prices and easing global bond yields as drivers behind its more cautious outlook for the December MPC meeting.
items.title: SBI Research Cuts December RBI Rate-Hike Forecast to 25 Basis Points

items.summary: Eugenio Sanchez Pelayo and Gary Harper extend earlier Bank of England analysis by four years, finding the pandemic-era premium on houses over similar flats did persist. The estimated rise held through higher mortgage rates and lower transaction volumes, though they advise caution about a late 2025 increase due to possible new-build registration revisions. They also find London’s relative weakness began around 2016–17 and continued after Covid, partly explaining weak London-flat performance. Sanchez Pelayo and Harper work in the Data and Statistics Division; views are their own.
items.title: Bank of England finds pandemic house revaluation persisted

items.summary: The New York Fed updated its banking system vulnerability analysis using four models through 2026:Q2, reporting a $151.1 billion capital gap under the “2022 redux” scenario versus $161.3 billion previously (quantity-2316-2330). Liquidity and run vulnerabilities also rose; authors note figures remain moderate historically but elevated since 2015–2022, with a disclaimer that views are the authors’ own.
items.title: New York Fed Updates U.S. Banking System Vulnerability Analysis

items.summary: Nvidia is on track for the largest one-day market value wipeout ever, Bloomberg reported. Its market value fell below $4 trillion to under $3.8 trillion, trailing Apple and Microsoft, with its lowest level since June 2025. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO amid reports of two extramarital affairs; Colette Kress is interim CEO. The stock has lost about 35%, or $2 trillion, since October's record.
items.title: Nvidia Faces Record Market Value Drop After CEO Resignation

items.summary: Alphabet raised about $3.8 billion through its first Hong Kong dollar and Singapore dollar bond sales, according to Reuters. The company had set a goal of $3 billion across the two sales. It sold HK$16 billion ($2 billion) of Hong Kong dollar bonds in tranches, and S$2.28 billion ($1.78 billion) of Singapore dollar bonds, according to Bloomberg. HSBC and JPMorgan coordinated the sale, according to The Next Web. Proceeds are earmarked for general business needs, a category that could cover paying down existing borrowings, according to Bloomberg.
items.title: Alphabet Raises $3.8 Billion in Hong Kong and Singapore Bonds

items.summary: The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland added median PCE inflation data to FRED, which tracks the underlying trend in consumer prices by ranking price changes across spending categories and selecting the middle value. This measure looks past month-to-month swings caused by volatile items such as gasoline or airfares, focusing instead on broad shifts in the distribution of price changes.
items.title: FRED Adds Cleveland Fed Median PCE Inflation Data

items.summary: Wang Bing drives an electric lorry between Haikou and Dongfang on Hainan, covering about 500 kilometres (310 miles) each way. His truck now swaps batteries in five minutes or so instead of charging for an hour and half. He says the swap is much faster than before, that electricity costs less than oil, and his e-truck can save more than 20,000 yuan (£2,200) per month. CATL, which launched a lorry battery-swapping system through its Qiji Energy brand in 2023, plans to operate 900 stations by the end of this year and reach 2,000 by the end of 2027. Mao Shiyue notes swapping lowers upfront costs because batteries can be rented rather than bought outright. Xue Lulu cautions that drivers may still wait for off-peak times and are locked to one provider's battery type.
items.title: China's battery-swapping e-trucks may ease EV range anxiety

items.summary: An Instagram account called nswnewsroom posted a breaking claim about another Liberal MP quitting, appearing to be independent news but actually authorised by the NSW Labor state secretary. The Sydney Morning Herald prompted its authorisation label. Experts say such unbranded party accounts exploit gaps in digital election law.
items.title: NSW Labor Instagram Account Exposed as Party-Run News Page

items.summary: Nvidia's board removed CEO Jensen Huang effective immediately after reports of a second extramarital affair, appointing CFO Colette Kress as interim leader. The New York Times first reported the scandal; Megaspeed denies spying allegations and pledged cooperation with US investigators. Nvidia's market capitalization fell by well over $600 billion to $4.2 trillion since the first affair emerged, with shares down more than 9% in premarket trading Thursday. Analysts cite strategy risks but expect limited near-term sales impact given strong chip demand.
items.title: Nvidia Reshuffles Leadership After Jensen Huang Scandal Fallout

items.summary: Jensen Huang stepped down as chief executive of Nvidia after revelations that his affairs may have compromised the company’s security, including a relationship with Alice Huang, who heads Megaspeed, alleged to smuggle chips into China. The scandal reached the White House; Trump acknowledged calling Huang about whether he knew his partner was a spy but said he believed him and thought “he’ll be in good shape.” Nvidia lost $1.8 trillion of valuation since the story broke, with shares falling about 8% after-hours on Wednesday. Major shareholders pressed the board to remove Huang before the decline spread across the sector.
items.title: Nvidia Founder Jensen Huang Steps Down Amid Espionage and Infidelity Scandal

items.summary: Nvidia's chief executive Jensen Huang apologized for an extramarital affair in a message to employees, calling it unforgivable. The New York Times reported Wednesday that he had a second relationship with another Nvidia executive. His board is weighing whether to remove him as the company responds.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Faces Scandal Over Alleged Affairs and Possible Ouster

items.summary: Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, faces allegations of involvement in a suspected Chinese intelligence operation targeting Nvidia and its former CEO, Jensen Huang. Photographs from 2024 and an event in May 2025 showed the two together; she previously worked at Megaspeed International. Jensen Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife and apologised to his family and colleagues.
items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Spy Allegations

items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive after reports of two extramarital affairs, one with Alice Huang, a woman accused of spying for China. The company announced the departure without giving a reason and did not confirm the allegations; Beijing rejected them. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a successor. Shares fell more than 10 percent in premarket trading Thursday.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Over Alleged Spy Affair

items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia chief executive after admitting two extramarital affairs, one with Alice Huang of Megaspeed, whom US intelligence reportedly linked to Chinese spying. The board named interim CEO Colette Kress and first-ever chair Harvey C. Jones. Shares fell up to 13% in early trading; about $800 billion (€720 billion) had been wiped from the company's value since the weekend.
items.title: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigns amid China spy allegations

items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive, president and board member effective immediately after admitting an affair with a Chinese business associate. The company launched an independent investigation following his acknowledgement; US intelligence reportedly determined the woman was gathering information for China, though Beijing denied the spying allegations. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO. Shares plunged 13 per cent in early trading, and Nvidia stock has shed at least 24 per cent over the past month. Nvidia said it had "no reason to believe" national security or its secrets were compromised. A proposed class action accuses both of defrauding shareholders by concealing Mr Huang's ties with Ms Huang.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Over Alleged Spy Affair

items.summary: Apollo Global Management has provided and arranged more than $15 billion of debt for SoftBank Group since 2021, people familiar with the matter said. The lending helps fuel Maysayoshi Son’s nearly $65 billion bet on OpenAI. As Apollo adopts a more defensive stance toward AI investing, its ability to continue financing one of OpenAI’s largest investors becomes a test of whether private credit can fill gaps left by traditional lenders.
items.title: Apollo’s SoftBank Lending Funds OpenAI Bet

items.summary: US President Donald Trump threatened Thursday to immediately double tariffs on Mexico unless Mexican authorities stop what he called large migrant caravans advancing toward the southern US border. Linking the surge to Tuesday's midterm losses, Trump claimed an invasion was resuming and that huge caravans were beginning an illegal march through Mexico. The Mexican government issued no immediate statement.
items.title: Trump threatens doubled tariffs on Mexico over migrant caravans

items.summary: On November 12, 2026, Rwanda and China commemorate the 55th anniversary since they established formal diplomatic relations on November 12, 1971. Emmanuel Karenzi Karake serves as Rwanda's Ambassador to China. The two countries signed 15 bilateral cooperation agreements during a historic state visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping in July 2018. In September 2024, Presidents Kagame and Xi elevated the relationship to a comprehensive strategic partnership at the FOCAC Summit. Cooperation spans infrastructure, trade, technology and AI, with China supporting Rwanda's National Strategy for Transformation 2 covering 2024–2029 as it pursues upper-middle-income status by 2035.
items.title: Rwanda and China mark 55 years of diplomatic partnership

items.summary: At the Antalya summit of COP31 on November 11, 2026, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for cooperation amid record 2025 emissions. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan stressed climate finance access and responsibility of developed nations. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese urged clean energy investment and warned no one must be left behind as projected warming falls to around 2.6 degrees.
items.title: COP31 Leaders Urge Climate Action and Finance Reform

items.summary: Chinese Vice President Han Zheng attended the Antalya Leaders' Summit of COP31 in Turkey on Wednesday and delivered a national statement, presenting a four-point proposal to strengthen global climate governance. She called for full implementation of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Paris Agreement, accelerated green transition, disaster resilience, and deeper international cooperation, including support for developing countries. China reaffirmed its 2030 targets: raising non-fossil energy's share in electricity generation to 50% and increasing electricity's share in final energy consumption to 35%, while remaining committed to carbon peak and neutrality goals.
items.title: Chinese VP Han Zheng urges collective climate action at COP31

items.summary: Andrea Castillo, a Mexican university student, describes how her view of Chinese products changed after firsthand experience. She states that affordable prices do not mean low quality. The piece frames her account as showing how real-life encounters can challenge cultural prejudices she held since childhood.
items.title: Mexican Student Reassesses Views on Chinese Goods Through Direct Experience

items.summary: A government-commissioned review led by Alan Milburn is expected to propose barring under-25s from the health element of universal credit and personal independence payments, replacing them with a youth allowance. The interim report cited about 981,000 Neets across the UK.
items.title: Milburn review could overhaul UK welfare system for young people

items.summary: Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned as Indonesia's vice president on Thursday after court rulings disputed his overseas education credentials, which he needed to meet election requirements. Prabowo Subianto accepted the resignation with a heavy heart, praising Raka's service across 35 provinces and 303 projects. A parliamentary process may now select a replacement within 60 days.
items.title: Indonesia's Vice President Resigns Amid Eligibility and Academic Questions

items.summary: Ganquan Dao is a small island in the South China Sea surrounded by salt water, yet it holds a well of fresh water that supports life there. The item poses questions about where this water comes from and how it has made life possible on the island, without stating its source or describing the mechanism behind it.
items.title: Fresh Water on Ganquan Dao Island Explained

items.summary: The island Ganquan Dao is surrounded by salt water, yet beneath it lies fresh water. For generations the remote outpost has offered fishermen shelter in the vast South China Sea. For Xu Dehui, years caring for the island's wildlife and plants have turned this distant place into home.
items.title: Ganquan Dao Island Becomes a Fisherman's Home

items.summary: Kress becomes interim chief executive as Nvidia navigates Jensen Huang's departure following revelations about his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. She previously served at Cisco and joined the chipmaker in 2013, where she worked for nearly 25 years before that point. Forbes ranks her No. 32 on its 2026 list of America's richest self-made women, valuing her shares at roughly $750 million as of Wednesday's close.
items.title: Nvidia Names Kress Interim CEO After Huang's Departure

items.summary: Jensen Huang is stepping down as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member with immediate effect. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor, and Harvey Jones has become its first-ever board chairman. Shares fell more than 10% in premarket trading following the announcement.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Controversy and Uncertainty

items.summary: Nvidia said on Thursday that its chief executive, Jensen Huang, is stepping down as interim leader Colette Kress takes over while the company searches for a permanent successor. Reports of affairs with two women, one linked to Chinese intelligence, intensified scrutiny and led Nvidia's board to launch an investigation into whether he was targeted by foreign operatives.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Spy Allegations

items.summary: Colette Kress is interim CEO of Nvidia as the board searches for a permanent chief after reports that Jensen Huang was removed over alleged affairs, including one with Alice Huang. Stock slid 10% to $156 [quantity-745-748] [quantity-752-756], its level last seen in June 2025 [date-801-805]. Federal and congressional investigations into the couple continue, while analysts cite internal names such as Ian Buck. Nvidia reports fiscal third-quarter results on November 17 [s57], when investors will weigh leadership against data centre revenue.
items.title: Nvidia Names Interim CEO Amid Jensen Huang Exit and Investigations

items.summary: Shares of Nvidia fell about 13% in opening trade on Thursday, as its market value dropped below $4 trillion for the first time since July 2025. The decline followed reports that chief executive Jensen Huang resigned amid allegations involving a Chinese businesswoman suspected by US authorities of spying for Beijing. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while Nvidia searches for a permanent replacement.
items.title: Nvidia Shares Fall Sharply After CEO Jensen Huang Resignation

items.summary: Shares of Nvidia fell 13 percent in Thursday opening trading after Chief Executive Jensen Huang resigned, following revelations he had an affair with a woman accused of spying for China. The declines left the company having lost about $800 billion this week.
items.title: Nvidia Shares Fall After Jensen Huang Resignation

items.summary: An evening newswrap covers several stories. AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad formed the Samajik Parivartan Morcha for 2027 UP polls, naming Azad as their chief ministerial candidate. Nvidia's board reportedly weighs CEO Jensen Huang's future amid revelations about alleged relationships involving a woman suspected of Chinese intelligence links. India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, breaching the RBI's upper tolerance limit of 6%. PM Modi exchanged Diwali greetings with Congress leader Sam Pitroda.
items.title: UP Alliance and Nvidia Board Turmoil Headline Indian Newswrap

items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive after reports of two affairs, including one with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed International. Colette Kress was named interim CEO while the board works with outside counsel to identify replacements among candidates such as Lisa Su and Sanjay Mehrotra. Nvidia shares have soared more than 700,000% since its 1999 public listing, and the firm’s valuation has topped $5 trillion. Analyst Stacy Rasgon downgraded the stock to “market-perform” with a price target of $200, warning that leadership instability could affect operations.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Affair Revelations

items.summary: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia's head on Thursday, November 12, following revelations about extramarital relationships with two women. The board appointed Colette Kress, the company's executive vice president and chief financial officer, as interim CEO until a permanent successor is named. Kress joined in September 2013 after roughly 25 years of experience across major technology companies.
items.title: Nvidia Names Colette Kress Interim CEO After Jensen Huang's Departure

items.summary: Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang has stepped down from his leadership positions after resigning on Thursday following revelations about extramarital affairs with a subordinate executive and a woman identified by US officials as a Chinese spy. Colette Kress, the current chief financial officer, was appointed interim CEO and will retain her role until a permanent replacement is named. Shares of Nvidia fell 10% in premarket trading on Thursday.
items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Spy Controversy; CFO Named Interim Leader

items.summary: According to the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development’s ‘International Migration Outlook – 2026’ report, Indians topped the list of people acquiring citizenship in advanced economies between 2020 and 2024. Around 9.25 lakh Indian citizens acquired OECD nationality during that period, a rise of 41% from just over 6.5 lakh five years earlier (quantity-100-109 quantity-394-397). India remained the largest source country ahead of Syria and Mexico nationals at around 5.9 lakh each (quantity-678-686). The report attributes the increase to growing Indian communities, particularly in Canada, where 2.61 lakh Indians became citizens over the period. OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann said immigrants now account for 16% of employment across the bloc and urged better access to jobs and finance.
items.title: Indians Lead OECD Citizenship Acquisitions in 2020-24
